title: Maula Ka Matamdar
body:
Ya Hussain.... (8)
Har Matami Mein Aqse Hussain Ibne Ali Ho,
Qirdar Mein Guftaar Mein Pairowe Ali Ho,
Shabbir Ki Awaaz Pe Kehta Hai Joh Labbaik,
Mumkin Nahi Usse Kabhi Naraz Jali Ho,
Shabbir Ke Sajde Ka Bharam Jisne Rakha Hai,
Naize Pe Tilawat Ko Subh O Shaam Padha Hai,
Dar Asl Wahi Deen E Mohammad Ka Wafadar,
Uske Hi Hain Maula Saqhi Abbas Alamdar,
Peeran E Peer Aaqa Ali Haider E Qarrar,
Woh Hazrat E Shabbir Ka Jidaar Hai Ghumkhwaar,
Woh Syeda Zahra Ki Duaaon Se Azadar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Deen E Haq Ka Salaar,
Deen E Haq Ka Salaar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Awaaz E Azaan Jab Sunta Hai Masjid Ki Taraf Rukh Karta Hai,
Nauke Naiza Pe Zikr E Qur'an Sunkar Wajib Hai Padhta Hai,
Hota Hai Zimmedar..
Hota Hai Zimmedar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Majlis Ki Saffon Mein Rehta Hai Matam Ikhlaas Se Karta Hai,
John O Hurr Ki Tarha Se Woh Maula Ka Hi Dam Bharta Hai,
Karta Hai Jaan Nisaar..
Karta Hai Jaan Nisaar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Halmin Nasir Ko Sunta Hai Phir Wehab E Qalbi Banta Hai,
Peeri Mein Habib Ki Tarha Se Haq Ke Rastey Pe Chalta Hai,
Hota Hai Woh Dee'ndar..
Hota Hai Woh Dee'ndar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Woh Shirk O Ghina Se Bachta Hai Pakeeza Raah Ko Chunta Hai,
Zahra Ki Duaa Hai Yeh Rutba Har Dam Woh Zehan Mein Rakhta Hai,
Kehlata Hai Ghumkhwaar..
Kehlata Hai Ghumkhwaar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Deen E Haq Ka Joh Haamil Hai Imaan Bhi Uska Qaamil Hai,
Abbas Ki Jurrat Aur Ghairat Iske Qirdar Mein Shaamil Hai,
Banta Hai Phir Jidaar..
Banta Hai Phir Jidaar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Baaton Se Nahi Qirdaaron Se Maqsad Se Aur Afqaaron Se,
Aashiq Maidan Mein Ladta Hai Tahna Lakhon Talwaaron Se,
Misl E Mesum E Tammar..
Misl E Mesum E Tammar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Olema Ki Izzat Laazim Hai Hukm E Maula Pe Sar Kham Hai,
Tazeem Wahi Bas Karta Hai Shabbir Ka His Dil Mein Gham Hai,
Joh Na Mane Gaddar..
Joh Na Mane Gaddar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Joh Aal E Ali Ko Kehde Bura Pairowe Shimr O Khauli Bana,
Rehbar Aulaad E Zehra Hain Inka Dushman Dushman E Zehra,
Be Amal Hai Woh Bekaar..
Be Amal Hai Woh Bekaar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Zikr E Shabbir Ibadat Hai Momin Ke Liye Sa'adat Hai,
Joh Peshawar Hai Uske Liye Zikr E Shabbir Tijarat Hai,
Karta Hi Nahi Beo'paar..
Karta Hi Nahi Beo'paar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Aalim Se Ilm Samjhta Hai Phir Zikr E Ali Woh Karta Hai,
Jahil Ki Shirkiyan Baaton Se Woh Nasl Bacha Ke Chalta Hai,
Jahil Se Hai Bezaar..
Jahil Se Hai Bezaar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
ALI DEEP Yeh Teri Qismat Hai Duniya Mein Aaj Joh Izzat Hai,
Yeh Paak Batool Ka Sadqah Hai Yeh Zikr Tujhe Ek Neymat Hai,
Tera Yeh Iftekhar..
Tera Yeh Iftekhar Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar
Maula Ka Matamdar...(2)
Maula Ka Matamdar...
Maula Ka Matamdar...
